# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Aug 19, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's focus was on enhancing stability and developer experience, with significant bug fixes in `op-batcher` and `op-devstack`, along with substantial work on the Rust-based `kona` and `lokahi` components, including new CLI tools and CI improvements.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Core Infrastructure Bug Fixes
Critical bugs were addressed in core components, including a data race in `op-batcher`'s throttling endpoints and a fix for `op-devstack`'s L1 HTTP poll interval being misinterpreted as nanoseconds. Security updates for Rust dependencies were also rolled out.
- [#22470](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22470)
- [#22500](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22500)
- [#22499](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22499)

### Rust Ecosystem Development and Refinement
Significant progress was made in the Rust ecosystem, particularly with `kona` and the new `lokahi` (formerly `rust-supernode`). This included centralizing Holocene span batch checks, adding proposer ports for L1 queries and superroot/execution, and collapsing `kona-safedb` versions into a single implementation. The `rust-supernode` was renamed to `lokahi` and received a minimal CLI skeleton, with shared version accessors across `op-version`, `rust-supernode`, and `kona-node`.

### CI/CD and Testing Improvements
The CI pipeline saw updates including bumping the Rust nightly pin, removing an unused Docker image, and installing apt packages from Ubuntu mirrors. Testing efforts included adding a CLI surface snapshot test for `op-reth`, marking a `TestSequencerFailover_ConductorRPC` as flaky, and removing the `FlakyOnOpReth` test helper as all acceptance tests now run with `op-reth`.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### P2P Connection Stability
The issue regarding `op-reth` and `op-geth` P2P connection flakiness in `sysgo` tests has been closed. The problem was resolved by normalizing peer IDs and removing the `SKIP_P2P_CONNECTION_CHECK` workaround, re-enabling P2P connection verification in Rust e2e sysgo jobs.
- [#18570](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18570)

### PCD Milestone 3 Completion
The "Quality and Benchmarking" milestone for the PCD (Protocol-Controlled Deployments) has been completed, involving a thorough review and benchmarking of the new deployment pipeline.
- [#20900](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20900)

## NEW ISSUES

### `lokahi` (Rust Multi-Chain Interop Node) Development Roadmap
A comprehensive set of issues has been opened to track the development of `lokahi`, the Rust multi-chain interop node. This includes:

- Refactoring `kona-node`'s per-chain machinery for `lokahi` composition [#22520](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22520).
- Scaffolding an N-chain node without interop [#22521](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22521).
- Implementing the interop actor and cross-safe happy path [#22522](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22522).
- Handling invalidation and deposits-only block replacement [#22523](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22523).
- Achieving RPC parity, sequencing, and test harness for `lokahi` [#22524](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22524).
- Consolidating shared message-validity rules in `kona-interop` [#22534](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22534).
- Defining stores for the interop actor (verifiedDB, WAL, logsDBs, invalidated-output archive) [#22535](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22535).
- Implementing the verification round loop [#22536](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22536).
- Wiring the interop actor as the promotion source for cross-safe lifecycle and finality [#22537](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22537).
- Adding acceptance coverage for the happy path of 2-chain `lokahi` cross-safe [#22538](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22538).
- Implementing the `Invalidate` decision path in the round loop [#22540](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22540).
- Handling `DecisionRewind` for L1 reorgs [#22542](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22542).
- Ensuring end-to-end invalidation coverage in `op-acceptance-tests` [#22543](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/22543).
